attempted_claim: Let ex_3(n,s) be the maximum number of edges in an n-vertex triangle-free graph with independence number at most s, and for each integer j≥1 let g_j(n,s)=j(j−1)n²/2−j(3j−4)ns+(3j−4)(3j−1)s²/2. Is ex_3(n,s)=min_{j≥1} g_j(n,s) for every pair of integers n/3<s≤n/2 (equivalently, is the triangle Ramsey–Turán density f_3(α) equal to the associated piecewise-quadratic function for every α∈(1/3,1/2])?
decisive_failure: Small-order ILP verification covered only n<=8 to optimality; exhaustive circulant scan to n=35 covers only vertex-transitive examples; heuristic searches (annealing, blow-up hill-climbing) are incomplete by design; literature status rests on one fetched paper version. None of these limitations affect the NO_RESULT verdict, since no claim is made.
